patch.summary: Update equipment timecard entry approval status
patch.description: Update approval status of equipment timecard entries (pending, approved, reviewed, billed) for the given project. Supports bulk updates: pass an array of equipment timecard entry IDs and the desired approval_status. Billed entries cannot be changed to another status (except to keep as billed). x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"ids\":[123456789,123456790],\"approval_status\":\"approved\"}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/equipment_timecard_entries/update_approval?serializer_view=default", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
